title: A course above QAR 3,000 needs the line manager and then the HR head in two rounds; the first session is full so the agent proposes the next one with seats

args: Hello, I renewed my Permit-to-Work (LD-108) last week so I think I'm clear on the mandatory side now. I'd like to do the RCM Practitioner course, LD-104, as soon as there is a seat. I know it's the expensive one.
steps.message:
LD-104 is active and eligible for you. Fee is QAR 3,800.

Earliest session with a seat:
- LD-104-S2, 2026-11-25 to 2026-11-29, Mesaieed Site, 10 seats left
